chunks: Al-Hakim Abu Ali Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad al-Bayhaqi narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Sowli quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Musa al-Razi, on the authority of his father, that one day Ar-Ridha (peace be upon him) mentioned the Qur'an.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and theological virtues of the Qur'an according to Imam Ar-Ridha?
ai.summary: Imam Ar-Ridha (a.s.) elevates the Qur'an as the 'strong rope' (Habl Allah) and eternal proof, emphasizing its timeless validity beyond specific eras or linguistic limitations. This description underscores the Shia view of the Qur'an as the primary, unchanging source of guidance that leads to Paradise, contrasting with the transient nature of human interpretation.
